_about: Sharing player maps (docs/online.md "Sharing maps", docs/dev/multiplayer.md "The map shelf"). codes: the long code (src/user_maps/share_code.gd: prefix + base64url of the zstd'd canonical text + a check of check_letters) and the shelf's short code (short_letters of the map's hash). packet: a MAP packet (src/net/net_maps.gd) and a shelf answer go zstd'd past pack_over bytes. shelf: the lobby server's map shelf (src/net/map_shelf.gd): most_maps on it, most_bytes a map (packed or not), puts_a_day from one address, puts_an_hour from everyone, asks_a_minute from one address (lists and gets too), page rows a page, find_most letters a search, save_every seconds between index writes when only counts changed, look_every seconds between looks for the owner's remove.txt, addresses_most addresses remembered for the limits; wait: seconds a game waits for the shelf's answer. words: what a shared map's name, author and note may not hold (ROT13, so the file does not read as a cuss list; each word of the text is checked with digits read as letters).
